recoveryAlerts.title: Could not update the recovery copy: Recovery journal belongs to a different document

sourceCause.finding: prepare replaced active project with g4 through setProject after launcher started its own persistence journal.
startSession owns recoveryJournalId until canonical suspend/start; runRecoverySave captures the current document and appends under that journal.
appendRecoverySnapshot rejects stored.documentId differing from incoming snapshot.documentId with the exact observed error.
leave and activateProject own asynchronous teardown, media replacement, setProject, local binding and fresh persistence start.
